title: fix(plugin-kanban,i18n): a kanban card's description names no key the board lacks (objectui#12837)
body:
Fixes #12837
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

Every kanban card's `aria-describedby` pointed at dnd-kit's default English instructions: "To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys …". The board builds only `PointerSensor` and `TouchSensor`, so Space moves nothing, and the text stayed English under every locale.

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx`: the board's existing `dndAccessibility` memo now passes `screenReaderInstructions: { draggable: t('kanban.dnd.instructions') }` beside the objectui#12716 `announcements`. The key is added to `useKanbanT`'s inline defaults, the same way as the other `kanban.dnd.*` keys. The sensors, the announcements, drag-and-drop behaviour, every `data-testid` and the lane and swimlane `aria-label`s are unchanged.
- `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`: one new key, `kanban.dnd.instructions`, in all ten packs.
- `packages/plugin-kanban/README.md`: the "Accessible" line now matches what ships.
- One changeset, patch for `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## The sentence

- en: "To move this card to another column, drag it with a pointer or by touch."
- zh: "如需将此卡片移到其他列，请用鼠标或触控拖动它。"

It names no key because no key moves a card. Keyboard drag (a `KeyboardSensor` with cross-lane coordinates) is a new capability that the triage grade holds for the maintainer, and this PR does not build it.

## Does any keyboard route change a card's column today?

No, measured on the showcase task board. A focused card does nothing on Enter or Space. Only a pointer click opens the card's record (the URL moves to the record page). The board has no other control that moves a card. So the sentence names no keyboard route.

## Space and Enter on a focused card (zh-CN, showcase task board, card "Evidence collection")

| | `main` `64acb7e` | this branch `4057737` |
|---|---|---|
| description | "To pick up a draggable item, press the space bar. While dragging, use the arrow keys to move the item. Press space again …" | "如需将此卡片移到其他列，请用鼠标或触控拖动它。" |
| Space | nothing: live region empty, no `aria-pressed`, focus stays | nothing (same) |
| Enter | nothing: URL unchanged, no dialog | nothing (same) |

A card's role is `listitem`: the board writes it after spreading dnd-kit's attributes. dnd-kit therefore never sets `aria-pressed` on a card. Enter and Space doing nothing on a focused card is reported separately and not changed here.

## README line

- Before: "Accessible: Built on @dnd-kit with keyboard navigation support"
- After: "Accessible: Drag announcements and each card's description read in the viewer's language (objectui#12716, objectui#12837). Cards move by pointer or touch drag; there is no keyboard drag."

## Deviations

None in the file surface. One changeset file covers both packages.

## Screenshots (light, zh-CN; the caption is a test-page overlay showing the focused card's accessible description, not part of the product)

- Before (`main`): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/e5029552b5e00adb5635a86ffb32be74c4d87225/docs/design/findings/12837/main-before-zh-light.png?raw=true
- After (this branch): https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/e5029552b5e00adb5635a86ffb32be74c4d87225/docs/design/findings/12837/branch-after-zh-light.png?raw=true

The screenshots live on the evidence branch `claude/issue-12837-evidence` and are never merged.

## Tests (head `4057737`)

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/dndInstructions-12837.test.tsx` uses the real board and the real `DndContext`. It wraps only `useSensor`, to record the sensors.

- Under en and under zh, the card's `aria-describedby` target equals the bundle sentence and contains none of space, Space, 空格, arrow or 方向键.
- CONTROL: the board builds `PointerSensor` and `TouchSensor` and no `KeyboardSensor`.
- CONTROL: Space on a focused card leaves the live region unchanged and reports no `aria-pressed=true`.
- The objectui#12716 pins (`dndAnnouncements-12716.test.tsx`) pass unchanged.

Ablations ran through `ablation-replace.mjs`. Each anchor hit once, and each restore was verified with `git diff HEAD` empty.

| ablation | result |
|---|---|
| delete the `screenReaderInstructions` line | 2 red (en, zh), each reading dnd-kit's "To pick up a draggable item …" |
| import `KeyboardSensor` in place of `TouchSensor` | 2 red: both CONTROLs (with a keyboard sensor, Space starts a drag) |

Local gates on `4057737`:

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-kanban/`: exit 0, 74 files, 500 tests passed.
- `type-check`, `lint` (normal mode, 0 errors, no new warning) and `build` for `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/i18n`: all exit 0.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: all exit 0.
